title: Valid Early Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization. Existing memorization detection methods for unconditional diffusion models typically operate at a pre-selected timestep and therefore cannot adapt the detection time to the evolving denoising trajectory. Sequential monitoring enables adaptive detection but repeated testing across timesteps complicates trajectory-level false-alarm control. We study two ways of combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring for prompt-free memorization detection: per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score. The former controls repeated testing by splitting the false-alarm budget across timesteps, whereas the latter calibrates the event of ever crossing a threshold directly through the trajectory-level maximum. We evaluate this formulation on an unconditional CIFAR-1

translated_title: 扩散模型中记忆化的有效早期检测
translated_abstract: 扩散模型有时会复现其训练数据中的样本，这种现象被称为记忆化。现有的针对无条件扩散模型的记忆化检测方法通常在预先选定的时间步上运行，因此无法根据不断演化的去噪轨迹自适应地调整检测时机。序贯监测能够实现自适应检测，但在多个时间步上的重复测试使得轨迹层面的误报控制变得复杂。我们研究了将分割共形校准与序贯监测相结合以实现无提示记忆化检测的两种方法：逐时间步的Bonferroni校准，以及对最大记忆化分数的直接轨迹级校准。前者通过将误报预算分配到各时间步来控制重复测试，而后者则直接通过轨迹层面的最大值对“越过阈值”这一事件进行校准。我们在无条件的CIFAR-1（摘要在此处被截断）上评估了这一方法。
tldr: 该论文提出将分割共形校准与序贯监测相结合的两种方法（逐时间步Bonferroni校准和轨迹级最大记忆化分数直接校准），实现了扩散模型记忆化的无提示自适应早期检测，同时保证轨迹层面的有效误报控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two methods combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring—per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score—enabling prompt-free adaptive early detection of memorization in diffusion models with valid trajectory-level false-alarm control.
